description: Borrower-facing home affordability estimate: given gross income, existing monthly debts, down payment, and front-end/back-end DTI caps, compute the max monthly payment, max loan amount, and max home price. Surfaces the max_loan annuity engine. If no rate is supplied, the current best market rate for the state is used.

back_end_dti.description: Total-debt DTI cap as a decimal. Default 0.36.

down_payment.description: Cash down payment in dollars. Default 0.

front_end_dti.description: Housing-payment DTI cap as a decimal. Default 0.28.

monthly_debts.description: Existing recurring monthly debt payments. Default 0.

product_type.description: Product for the market-rate lookup. Default mortgage.

rate.description: Optional annual interest rate, e.g. 6.5. If omitted, best market rate is used.

state.description: US state code for the market-rate lookup. Default CA.

name: estimate_affordability

affordable.description: True when the income supports a meaningful loan after debts; false means the DTI budget is exhausted, not that nothing is purchasable.

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs the caller did not supply that were filled in with defaults. State these explicitly to the user, since they drive the numbers.

back_end_dti.description: Back-end (total-debt) DTI cap assumed, as a decimal (0.36 = 36%).

front_end_dti.description: Front-end (housing-only) DTI cap assumed, as a decimal (0.28 = 28%).

monthly_debts.description: Existing monthly debt payments in dollars assumed.

product_type.description: Product type assumed when resolving the market rate.

state.description: State code assumed for market-rate lookups because the caller did not supply one.

term_months.description: Loan term in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

back_end_budget_value.description: Total monthly debt budget in dollars under the back-end DTI cap, including existing debts. Compare with max_payment_value to see the headroom.

binding_constraint.description: Which limit caps the budget: 'front_end_dti' (housing payment alone) or 'back_end_dti' (all debts). This tells the user what to fix to buy more.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

down_payment.description: Down payment in dollars assumed, as a formatted string.

max_home_price.description: Largest purchase price in dollars, being the max loan amount plus the down payment.

max_loan_amount.description: Largest loan principal in dollars that payment supports at the rate and term used.

max_monthly_payment.description: Largest housing payment in dollars supported by the binding DTI constraint, as a formatted string.

max_payment_value.description: The same maximum housing payment as a raw number in dollars, for further math.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

note.description: Explanation of how the front-end and back-end DTI caps interact and which one binds.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

rate_used.description: Interest rate, in percent, used for every calculation in this result. Check rate_source to see whether it came from the caller or from live market data.

reason.description: Why the affordable amount is constrained or zero, present only in that case — e.g. 'Existing debts exceed the back-end DTI budget.'
